topics.summary: A new US proposal suggests Ukraine could trade Donbas for NATO membership, potentially altering the conflict's future.
The Transportation Secretary defended the FAA's nationwide ground stop, emphasizing safety after a system outage.
Apple plans to make Siri-powered AI apps the key feature of its upcoming smart glasses, shaping future tech interaction.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is criticized for a questionable business deal, raising concerns about AI industry leadership.
Pope Francis concluded his Peru trip, visiting remote communities in the Andes and Amazon regions.
Patriots and Lions star players Drake Maye and Aidan Hutchinson sustained injuries during their game in Munich.

items.joke:
A girl tells her friend, "I met an exchange student last night. He's a !Kung tribesman from Namibia."
"How did you get along?" asks her friend.
And the girl says, "It was incredible. We just clicked."
items.explanation: It's a pun on 'clicked,' referring to both connection and click languages.

items.joke: Two fish in a tank. One turns to the other and says, "Do you know how to drive this thing?"

idiom.title: Kill two birds with one stone
idiom.interpretationEn: This idiom originates from Ancient Greece and literally means killing two birds with one stone, symbolizing accomplishing two goals with a single effort. The phrase is commonly used to describe situations where a single action effectively addresses two or more issues.
idiom.interpretationZh: 这个成语最早源于古希腊，字面意思是在一块石头上杀死两只鸟，代表用一次努力同时完成两个目标。这一短语经常用来描述那些能用一个简单行动同时解决两个或更多问题的情况。

examples.en: By carpooling, we can kill two birds with one stone — save money on gas and reduce our carbon footprint.
examples.zh: 通过拼车，我们可以一箭双雕 —— 省油钱又减少碳足迹。

examples.en: She went shopping to get groceries and gifts, killing two birds with one stone.
examples.zh: 她去购物，买了食品和礼物，一举两得。

examples.en: By studying for his exams on the train, he kills two birds with one stone — utilizing his travel time effectively.
examples.zh: 他在火车上复习考试，一举两得 —— 有效利用了旅行时间。

people.name: Patrick Mboma
people.extract: Henri Patrick Mboma Dem is a Cameroonian former professional footballer who played as a striker. He is the fourth all-time top goal-scorer for the Cameroon national team.
highlights: Fourth all-time top goal-scorer for Cameroon national team.

people.name: Michel Chasles
people.extract: Michel Floréal Chasles was a French mathematician.

people.name: Gloria Foster
people.extract: Gloria Foster was an American actress. She had acclaimed roles in plays such as In White America and Having Our Say, winning three Obie Awards during her career. Foster played the Oracle in The Matrix (1999) and its first sequel, The Matrix Reloaded (2003). She played the role of the mother of Yusef Bell in the miniseries The Atlanta Child Murders which aired in 1985.
highlights: Played the Oracle in The Matrix (1999).
